description.value: Tofino Brewing Co. is a locally rooted craft brewery and taproom that has been part of the Tofino community since April 2011, brewing West Coast-inspired beers including a Kelp Stout made with locally harvested kelp and a seasonal Spruce Tree Ale conditioned with fresh spruce tips. The taproom offers an evolving roster of small-batch beers alongside ciders, non-alcoholic options, and wine, with an on-site food truck partner (Picnic at the Brewery) serving grilled sandwiches and local charcuterie on the front patio. Dogs are welcome on the patios and kids are allowed with an adult, making it a relaxed and inclusive destination for visiting cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and rich. Contact details (phone 250-725-2899, address 691 Industrial Way, Tofino BC V0R 2Z0, email info@tofinobrewingco.com) all match OSM exactly, confirmed from the cart subpage. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('grab beers to-go', 'ALL MENU ITEMS CAN BE TAKEN AWAY') and vegan status is confirmed via website FAQ ('IS YOUR BEER VEGAN? Yes!'). No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging information appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, active craft brewery and taproom with confirmed takeout and an on-site food truck; a natural refreshment stop for touring cyclists arriving in Tofino. Bike parking status is unconfirmed but warrants a follow-up rather than exclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website's cart page lists the full address as '691 Industrial Way, Tofino, British Columbia, V0R 2Z0, Canada', confirming the OSM address. A site visit or direct contact would clarify bike parking and washroom availability.
